title: Hong Wang's Fields Medal win reignites debate across China over how its top researchers emerge
subhead: Wang, who chose to study in France and then the US immediately after earning her undergraduate degree, became a popular figure in China within days of receiving the Fields Medal, illustrating the limitations of the Chinese system, built on competition and early selection.

title: On Biarritz's Port des Pêcheurs, Casa Juan Pedro keeps the plancha tradition alive
subhead: 'Gourmet kiosks' (5/6). Across France, small kiosks serving local specialties are a favorite stop for holidaymakers. Casa Juan Pedro, tucked in the cove of the Port des Pêcheurs in Biarritz, is one such place, where the plancha grilling ritual has been passed down from father to son for over 40 years.

title: How the French government is convincing banks to loan to Le Pen's campaign
